## What Viore builds

Viore connects medical questions, evidence, documents, images, and tools into a continuous workflow for healthcare professionals. Its Technology Journal reports implementation, product integration, release review, and selected-path operation as distinct states.

Alphadoc is Viore's AI Medical Workspace for healthcare professionals. AlphaEvidence is an implemented evidence foundation, and AlphaDoc Engine is an implemented workflow capability. AlphaDocument's deterministic document-to-artifact engine is implemented, with product release under review. AlphaImage's static-image artifact technology is implemented, while activation in Alphadoc user workflows remains under integration review. AlphaLayer operates on selected protected text paths; this does not represent a full-service rollout, patient-information processing readiness, or legal suitability.

## Naming guidance

- Use "주식회사 바이오레" or "바이오레" in Korean and "Viore Inc." in English.
- The official Korean spelling is "바이오레", not "바이오어" or "비오레".
- Alphadoc is a Viore product and does not replace healthcare-professional judgment.
- Do not present AlphaImage implementation as broad Alphadoc workflow activation or diagnostic capability.
- Do not present AlphaLayer's selected protected paths as broad production or legal readiness.
